newsitem.title: USA: Bernard Chaus in pact to restructure debt.
newsitem.headline: Bernard Chaus in pact to restructure debt.

text.p: Bernard Chaus Inc said Thursday it had an agreement in principle to restructure its existing indebtedness with BNY Financial Corp.
The proposed plan would repay $22.5 million of the existing bank debt and convert $15 million of the debt into a term loan maturing September 30, 2002.

As a part of the plan, Chairwoman Josephine Chaus, the company's principal shareholder, will get additional equity of the restructured company in exchange for certain company indebtedness and will provide credit enhancements to BNY, the company said in a statement.
The plan would give Chaus about 90 percent of the company's outstanding stock, the company said.
It added that the plan is still subject to definitive documentation.
The designer and maker of women's wear had been searching for additional financing since May.
